notes.title: SILENT BREATH – Multiplayer Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]It has been a long silence… but behind it, I’ve been working on something bigger.
The [b]Multiplayer Update[/b] is real — and it’s coming sooner than you expect.[/p][p]Getting lost in the forest was terrifying on your own.
But when you step into the woods together with friends, the fear changes. It becomes something entirely new.[/p][p]Multiplayer has been the [b]most requested feature[/b], and I’ve listened.
At the same time, I’ve upgraded [b]SILENT BREATH[/b] to the latest engine version.
That means [b]better performance, smoother gameplay, and enhanced visual fidelity[/b] — making every step into the dark woods more immersive than ever.[/p][p]The [b]official trailer and gameplay footage[/b] will be revealed very soon.
This update is not just an expansion — it’s my way of thanking you for all the incredible support you’ve given [b]SILENT BREATH[/b].[/p][p]I can’t wait for you to experience this with your friends.
Stay close… the forest is calling.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861849/228438ee1c443f873c3f3f77f223bc1d0115ba8f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: WINTER UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]The [strike]Krampus[/strike] has arrived, ready to claim the naughty children and those who despise Christmas.[/b]

[i]Hello everyone! Thank you for your continued support! The weather has gotten cold enough, and finally, snow has reached the SILENT BREATH! Get ready to feel the chill both inside and out with our spine-chilling new update! [/i]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list][*] The first dynamic weather condition has been added! You will now encounter snow and snowstorms in the forest! (More weather events will come in future updates)
[*] A new deadly threat, Krampus, has been added! You’ll never know when he might show up!
[*] Some Christmas-themed decorations have been added.
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list][*] Lumen lighting speed has been adjusted, resolving the issue where daylight or nighttime transitions left the environment too bright or dark.
[*] Several performance optimizations have been made.
[*] Some scares has been visually adjusted.
[/list]
[b]ADJUSTMENTS:[/b]
[list][*] The gameplay pace has been slightly increased.
[/list]

[i]We will be announcing a new update and exciting features very soon. Stay tuned!
[/i]

If you experience any issues, please join the official Silent Breath Discord: https://discord.gg/silentbreath Thanks,

[b]EXODIAC STUDIOS[/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 3 & TRADING CARDS, BADGES AND MORE
notes.notes:
[i]Hey everyone, I hope you're all doing great! As you know, I've been hard at work lately, and it’s my absolute pleasure to announce the third major update for [b]SILENT BREATH![/b] 🎉

I can’t thank you enough for your amazing support—it truly means the world to me. To celebrate this milestone, we’re launching a special discount, hoping to welcome even more adventurers to join us.

Wishing you all thrilling adventures in this mysterious forest. Have fun out there! [/i]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list][*] A new scare has been added! (Expect to encounter the infamous Butcher more often!)
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list][*] DLSS status issue fixed: The current state of DLSS now displays correctly in the settings menu.
[*] BUNKER ENDING fixes: Resolved an issue where the microphone and some scares remained active after the ending.
[*] BUNKER ENDING trigger zone fixed: The trigger zone now functions as intended.
[*] Death after game ends: Fixed a bug where players could still die after the game reaches end.
[*] Gunslinger bug fixed: Resolved an issue where the Gunslinger could disable player's input.
[*] Some scares has been visually adjusted.
[*] Fixed an issue where creatures and scares did not immediately disappear at the end of the game, potentially causing problems.
[/list]
[b]ADJUSTMENTS:[/b]
[list][*] Various technical updates were implemented in the forest. (Addressed potential memory leak issues and Unreal-specific problems.) As a result, the forest should now feel much denser and more immersive!
[/list]
[b]STORE:[/b][list]
[*] Trading Cards, Badges, and Steam Emotes have been added!
[*] Steam Backgrounds have been added! Now you can bring the darkness of the forest to your profile.
[/list]
[b]SETTINGS:[/b][list]
[*] Added the option to toggle 4:3 aspect ratio (black bars on the sides)! Now you can enjoy the game in true full-screen mode if you prefer.
[/list]

[i]We will be announcing a new update and exciting features very soon. Stay tuned!
[/i]

If you experience any issues, please join the official Silent Breath Discord: https://discord.gg/silentbreath Thanks,

[b]EXODIAC STUDIOS[/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 2 & NEWS
notes.notes:
First of all, I’d like to express my deepest thanks to all of you. Over 100,000 people have now ventured and gotten lost in this mystical forest!

Although I’ve been quiet for a while, I’ve been working hard behind the scenes to make the game even better and more reachable. And now, I’m excited to share some great news, along with a special discount to celebrate!

EXODIAC STUDIOS is now [b]officially a PlayStation and XBOX partner![/b] We’re getting closer to experiencing the terror of the forest on our big screens!

[i]And finally, the 2nd major update of SILENT BREATH is here![/i]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list][*] New Deadly Threat.
[*] New Locations.
[*] A New Minor Ending (The beginning of breaking the cycle).
[*] New Scare.
[*] Redesigned flashlight (Now more realistic and shines further).
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed DLSS issue.
[*] Fixed a bug where another ending was triggered while dead.
[/list]

[b]ADJUSTMENTS:[/b]
[list][*] Added NavLinkProxies, enabling threats to move across the map in a more terrifying way.
[*] Adjusted MissingSpawner, ensuring the lost now spawn more consistently.
[*] Some scares have been reworked.
[/list]

[b]STORE:[/b][list]
[*] New achievements added.
[/list]

[b]SETTINGS:[/b][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the settings menu was drawn incorrectly on certain screens.
[*] Corrected some font errors in some languages.
[/list]

[i]We will be announcing a new update and exciting features very soon. Stay tuned!
[/i]


If you experience any issues, please join the official Silent Breath Discord: https://discord.gg/silentbreath Thanks,

[b]EXODIAC STUDIOS[/b]

notes.title: SILENT BREATH FIRST MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[i]First of all, hello everyone, I have left behind a tiring two weeks after release. I am grateful to everyone who supported me and everyone who made positive and constructive comments to the game. I resolved the bugs I observed and implemented the improvements with your feedback, and I continue to work at full speed. Regarding optimization, when I tested it with DLSS 3.7 on all DLSS supported cards, I observed around 80-120% performance. I got 50 or more fps on RTX20 series cards, with the highest graphics settings. I hope it will help you with your performance problems too. With all due respect, I love you all![/i]

[list]
[*] The player's interaction distance has been increased.
[*] Big sister's sound effect has been increased and an indicator has been added to the spawn moment.
[*] DLSS 3.7 added!
[*] Fixed some bugs that occurred when the player died.
[*] Microphone sensitivity increased. (Check before entering the game.)
[*] Font errors throughout the game have been fixed.
[*] Changed the "Crying for Help Sound Effect" in the opening scene. :)
[*] Added the ability to reassign keys.
[*] Invert Y Axis option have beed added.
[*] The settings menu totally re-designed and reworked.
[*] Main Menu button added to the pause menu.
[*] Some scares have been reworked.
[*] Fixed some nudity filter bugs.
[*] Fixed the issue where the flashlight would glitch after the blind sister got disappeared.
[*] Stalker has been made more dangerous.
[*] Secret mechanic have been added for the in-door campers.
[*] [b]New scares added![/b]
[*] [b]New lethal threats added! (Don't trust familiar faces too much.)[/b]
[/list]

If you experience any issues, please join the official Silent Breath Discord: https://discord.gg/silentbreath Thanks,

EXODIAC STUDIOS
